lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [nervous] I just broke Mister Pickle's window... and nobody saw me.
lines.caption: I just broke Mister Pickle's window and nobody saw me

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [mischievously] I saw you.
lines.caption: I saw you

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [panicked] Dottie! Please don't tell!
lines.caption: Dottie! Please don't tell!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [serious] That window costs two hundred dollars.
lines.caption: That window costs two hundred dollars

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [shocked] Two HUNDRED? [sad] I have four dollars... and a button.
lines.caption: Two HUNDRED? I have four dollars and a button

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [excited] Then we need a business. A lemonade stand!
lines.caption: Then we need a business A lemonade stand!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [shouting] Lemonade! One dollar! Fresh lemonade!
lines.caption: Lemonade! One dollar! Fresh lemonade!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sad] [sighs] Nobody is buying. We made zero dollars.
lines.caption: Nobody is buying We made zero dollars

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [confident] Because you're selling it wrong. Watch this.
lines.caption: Because you're selling it wrong Watch this

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [shouting] [excited] MAGIC lemonade! One sip makes you run SUPER fast! Only ten dollars!
lines.caption: MAGIC lemonade! One sip makes you run SUPER fast! Only ten dollars!

lines.speaker: max
lines.tts: [excited] Super fast? I'll take FIVE cups!
lines.caption: Super fast? I'll take FIVE cups!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [whispers] [nervous] Dottie, that's a lie. It's just lemons and water.
lines.caption: Dottie that's a lie It's just lemons and water

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [smug] It's called marketing. [excited] Look! Two hundred dollars!
lines.caption: It's called marketing Look! Two hundred dollars!

lines.speaker: max
lines.tts: [angry] Hey! I'm not faster. I'm just... sticky. I want my money back!
lines.caption: Hey! I'm not faster I'm just sticky I want my money back!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [nervous] Uh oh. [shouting] RUN!
lines.caption: Uh oh RUN!

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [curious] Why are you two hiding behind my bush?
lines.caption: Why are you two hiding behind my bush?

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [nervous] Mister Pickle... I broke your window. With my ball. [sad] I'm sorry.
lines.caption: Mister Pickle I broke your window With my ball I'm sorry

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [nervous] And I sold fake magic lemonade to pay for it.
lines.caption: And I sold fake magic lemonade to pay for it

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [calm] I know. I have a camera. [warmly] I was waiting to see if you would tell the truth.
lines.caption: I know I have a camera I was waiting to see if you would tell the truth

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [shocked] You KNEW? The whole time?
lines.caption: You KNEW? The whole time?

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [serious] Give the money back. Then you can work it off in my shop.
lines.caption: Give the money back Then you can work it off in my shop

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [annoyed] Work? [excited] In a CANDY shop? Okay!
lines.caption: Work? In a CANDY shop? Okay!

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [happy] One week later, the window is fixed. You two are free to go.
lines.caption: One week later the window is fixed You two are free to go

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [nervous] Actually... can we keep working here?
lines.caption: Actually can we keep working here?

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [curious] Why?
lines.caption: Why?

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [mumbling] No reason.
lines.caption: No reason

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [shocked] My candy! You ate ALL of it!
lines.caption: My candy! You ate ALL of it!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [cheerfully] We'll work that off too!
lines.caption: We'll work that off too!

lines.speaker: max
lines.tts: [curious] Hey... is the magic lemonade back?
lines.caption: Hey is the magic lemonade back?

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [shouting] NO!
lines.caption: NO!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [shouting] NO!
lines.caption: NO!
